facts.claim_en: The National Archives says there is generally no charge for basic military personnel and medical record information provided to veterans, next of kin and authorized representatives.

facts.quote: Generally there is no charge for basic military personnel and medical record information provided to veterans, next of kin and authorized representatives from Federal (non-archival) records.

facts.claim_en: The National Archives warns that some companies advertise DD Form 214 research services and charge a fee for copies.

facts.source_name: National Archives: Request Military Service Records
facts.quote: Some companies advertise DD Form 214 research services and will charge a fee for obtaining copies.

facts.claim_en: The National Archives asks you not to send a follow-up request before 90 days have passed, because it may cause further delays.
